details:
I have a feature request regarding the friend pane on the main menu. I have seen two main problems with its present layout. The first problem that presents itself is when I go through my friendlist; if they have changed their avatar from their familiar one I sometimes become confused as to who they are. Second, as the list grows I am having to scroll through the list for a long while to find specific people unless I know a specific name to search. I therefore submit the following feature requests to mitigate these inconveniences:

1) Add a feature to show the origin world in which you added each other as a friend.

This has several benefits, including serving as a momento to the origin of friendship. Also, if it's a person you've only met once so far at 3:30AM in a public lobby and you find yourself logging back in the next night and wonder "who might this be?", you can jog your memory ;-)

2) Add a feature to group and sort friends by a nameable category.

This allows easy searching and the ability to curate and organize your own address book within the environment. You might even implement this as "Friend Circles," akin to the Google+ model (at least in UX design).

Other potential additions to this system may include the use of VCard format to allow import/export capability and portability, and possibly the use of a vrc: URI to allow a VCard to allow a VRchat Username to be opened to this system. Example:

URL;VRChat:vrc:ZippytheHippy

I believe that these proposed features would be of great benefit to all users, whether novice or professional. 

Thank you for your considerations on these Feature Requests presented to you today. I do hope to hear back soon.

ZippytheHippy
title: [Feature Request] [Friend System] Origin Metadata Display & Grouping
